_comment: Default PC keyboard/mouse controls for ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN, keyed by the exact key_name / button_flag_names strings that appear in the per-frame annotation stream. Grounded in the observed input vocabulary of video_annotations_EldenRing-NightReign/ (scenes 0007/0008/0009). This player's layout is stock Nightreign except lock-on is rebound from the middle mouse button to mouse side-button 5 (verified against the video with gemini-2.5-flash, ~0.9 confidence).
LMENU: Surge Sprint (hold; LMENU is the virtual-key name for Left Alt)
LCONTROL: Modifier: Strong/Heavy Attack (Ctrl+LMB) and Two-Hand toggle (Ctrl+Wheel)
KEY_Q: Skill / Ash of War (tap to cast, hold to charge); also Back/Cancel in menus
RI_MOUSE_WHEEL: Switch Armament (wheel up = right hand, wheel down = left hand); with Ctrl = two-hand; zooms map when a menu is open
KEY_F: Event Action / Interact (open chest or door, examine, rest at Site of Grace, talk to NPC, activate Spectral Hawk / Spiritspring)
RI_MOUSE_BUTTON_5_DOWN: Lock-On / Reset Camera (rebound from the default Middle Mouse Button to mouse side-button 5)
RI_MOUSE_MIDDLE_BUTTON_DOWN: Place Position Pin / Ping (default lock-on slot, freed up by the button-5 rebind)
KEY_X: Display Location of Self / Pin at Feet
